name: the page sees a touch screen
the start screen explains the thumb controls and no longer sends phones to a PC
start button fully visible on a landscape phone
expr: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('.keycap.big').getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top >= 0 && r.bottom <= innerHeight })()

name: a tap on the start button starts the run
stick and jump button on screen; keyboard hints and the volume slider gone
stick area and jump button stay clear of the top panels
expr: (() => { const hit = (a, b) => a.left < b.right && b.left < a.right && a.top < b.bottom && b.top < a.bottom; const panels = [...document.querySelectorAll('.hud .panel')].map((p) => p.getBoundingClientRect()); return ['.stick-zone', '.jump'].map((s) => document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect()).every((a) => panels.every((b) => !hit(a, b))) })()

name: landscape keeps the tuned view angle
holding the stick walks the player (back, out onto the open floor)
expr: (() => { const p = window.__wakppu.info().player; return Math.hypot(p.x - window.__p0.x, p.z - window.__p0.z) > 1.5 && Math.hypot(p.x, p.z) > Math.hypot(window.__p0.x, window.__p0.z) })()

name: the jump button jumps while the other thumb holds the stick
the player keeps running through the jump
expr: (() => { const p = window.__wakppu.info().player; return Math.hypot(p.x - window.__j0.x, p.z - window.__j0.z) > 0.5 && !!document.querySelector('.stick.held') })()

name: letting go of the stick stops the player
expr: (() => { const p = window.__wakppu.info().player; return Math.hypot(p.x - window.__p1.x, p.z - window.__p1.z) < 0.05 && !document.querySelector('.stick.held') })()

name: a finger dragged across the view turns the camera
